terra.problem: It invents why Jonah chose Tarshish, says he had never been there, and implies Papa saw him pack. The text gives none of those details.
The claim that Jonah was running hard and did not stop for directions adds actions the text does not give.
Jonah gives his reason for fleeing, but the text does not say that the road or the Ninevites played no part in it.
The claim that Jonah was not scared of the walk adds a feeling the text does not give.
The text gives the LORD's question but does not describe His tone as gentle.
Calling the LORD's reply calm and saying nobody yells or argues adds tone and details the text does not give.
The claim that the question did more than a long speech could assigns it an effect the text does not state.
The mention of the fish brings in a fact from outside this passage without a reference.
The snack is a food in a joke that is not named in the passage or an answer on the card.
The text says the vine grew over Jonah's head, not on top of his shelter.
The text does not say it was a hot day when Jonah was pleased with the plant.
The claim that the vine was the only thing that changed is unsupported. Other events are described between Jonah's anger and his pleasure in the plant.
The text does not say how big the plant was.
The text does not say the worm attacked the plant quietly.
The claim that Jonah was only thinking about himself assigns him thoughts the text does not give.
